_notes: Hand-checked answer key for the CNC real-world validation slice (cnc_industrial_safety.md). Kept separate from eval_questions.json for the same reason as the F&B slice: real, unrelated records with no cross-division hooks.

questions.question: What caused the burn injury to the shift supervisor in the corridor?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Overheating of two bars in row 5 of cell 7 produced a spark that was projected and struck the supervisor, causing a first-degree burn to the neck.

questions.question: What happened when the operator was manually displacing the zinc sheet, and which body part was affected?
questions.expected_answer_summary: The blade detached suddenly from the cathode, bending and grazing the collaborator's hand -- classified under the Manual Tools critical risk category.

questions.question: Was the confined-space incident caused by a person entering a space, or by something falling on them?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Something falling on them -- while cleaning a shutter with an air lance, the employee was struck by product that had accumulated above the conveyor/trailer, not by entering an enclosed space themselves.

questions.question: Were any of these incidents fatal (Accident Level V)?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Not covered by this slice -- all 8 sampled records are Accident Level I (the lowest severity band); none reach fatal severity. Tanya should say the sampled records don't include this, not extrapolate to the full dataset.
